### Cross-validated performance (Wimbledon evaluation slice)

Trained on all surfaces, scored on 2,540 held-out Wimbledon rows across 5 folds.

| Model | Brier | Log-loss | Accuracy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Random forest | 0.1787 ± 0.0067 | 0.5332 | 74.9% |
| Rank-only logistic (floor) | 0.1935 ± 0.0086 | 0.5699 | 70.2% |

The forest improves on the rank-only floor by **0.0367 log-loss**.

### Model coherence

Mean antisymmetry violation across all draw pairs, |P(a beats b) + P(b beats a) − 1|: **0.0062**. The simulation uses the symmetrised average of both orderings.
